data.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend existing scrutiny prompts (preplanning red-team / blue-team / phase-e-adversarial-review; implementation-plan gap-analysis) with conditional Strata-violation checklist sections. Conditional sections OMITTED (not empty blocks) when epic lacks strata:scoped. Section header named "REQUIRED when strata:scoped tag present", positioned EARLY in prompt. Checklist content data-driven from decomposition.md structural-rules section. Validation checks: plan uses SDK generators; Case→Form via application_form_id:uuid (NOT belongs_to :case); Pundit policy required; generator flags hyphenated; chained generators not double-invoked; multi-concept consistency. Single shared facts load: orchestrator loads facts ONCE and passes content to each scrutiny reviewer; reviewers do NOT re-Read.
**Why**: Plan-validation closes the SDK-footgun loop without new sub-agents.
**Scope**:
- IN: Extension of existing scrutiny prompts; OMITTED-not-empty conditional sections; data-driven checklist from decomposition.md; orchestrator-shared facts pass.
- OUT: New sub-agents (epic explicitly excluded).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, bad-fixture plan with 4 footguns produces ≥4 findings citing decomposition.md rules ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, non-Strata epic produces byte-identical scrutiny output (diff against scrutiny-non-strata-baseline.txt exits 0) ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, conditional section is OMITTED on non-Strata epics — not present as empty block ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, parallel reviewers receive shared facts content from orchestrator (no duplicate Read in tool-use logs) ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for prompt rendering branches and orchestrator pass-through

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Section header position EARLY ensures reviewer reads it before plan content
- [Reliability] OMITTED conditional avoids byte-noise on non-Strata baseline

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a scrutiny reviewer, plan-validation extension catches SDK footguns when strata:scoped
